title: Lucky Thirteen Original Black Widow 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Black Widow from Lucky Thirteen’s Original Collection takes the succulent sweetness of Blackberry and pairs it with the warm spice of Aniseed, with a subtle streak of cooling Menthol for a rich and delicious vape you won’t be able to put down. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mods and sub-ohm tanks , producing rich clouds and immaculate flavour.
